text: Vanessa's puppy arrived Saturday, a little cockapoo called Biscuit. She's already sleep deprived lol
Jakub starts at the new firm on November 3rd. Wants to bike there but it's 9 miles each way
interview prep w/ Anya - she's up for the senior designer role at Kim & Evans, final round 5/14. pretty nervous, keeps saying she'll freeze on the portfolio bit. text her the morning of
Rosa's cat Pepper has kidney problems, vet says manage it with diet. Rosa's taking it hard.
Need to pick up a leaving card for Connor before Friday, his last day is the 31st
Cem got the promotion!! team lead from January. buy him a pint next time

Okay so just got off the phone with Valentina. Her dad is finally retiring, March 2027, after thirty-something years at the council. They're planning a big do for him, probably at the golf club, she'll send dates. Her brother Luis is flying back from Madrid for it. Also she mentioned she's applied for the head of ops job at her place, interview's sometime next month but she doesn't know when yet. Ask her how the application's going in a couple of weeks.
Simone hates her new manager. Already looking around.
Jun's dog Mochi turns 3 on June 3rd, he's doing a dog cake thing. absurd. love it
Dentist Thursday 9:15, then post office
Rana said the second interview went well but they're also seeing an internal candidate. hears back by Friday. check in with her Monday if nothing
James and Fern adopted two kittens from the rescue, Salt and Pepper, last weekend
Remind me to send Efua the job ad for the lab tech post, closing date is 2 November 2026

Chantal quit! Walked out on Tuesday apparently. Starting freelance. Her partner Andre is being very supportive but I think she's a bit scared about money. She's got one client lined up already, a small brewery, and wants to have a website up by December 1st. I should send her the name of the guy who did mine
Fatima's first day at the hospital was rough. Long shift, nobody showed her where anything was. Message her Thursday to see if week one got better
note: Kaito is vegetarian, allergic to cats. don't suggest Rosa's for the dinner
Zofia said her mum got made redundant, after 22 years. Zofia's trying to help her with her CV. Hasn't really sunk in for her mum yet I don't think.
Karan's leaving do is on the 14th - Nov 14 - at the Crown. I'm doing the collection for the gift, so far £85. He keeps hinting about a decent coffee grinder
Samir. Interview. Thursday 10am. Amazon warehouse supervisor. Wish luck!!
Hemi's old spaniel Bonnie was put to sleep yesterday. 14. He's gutted. Should drop round with something this weekend
lachlan nervous re driving test aug 12, failed the last one on parallel parking. he'll tell me how it goes

Antoine and Pieter got their puppy! Golden retriever, Otis. Pieter's taking two weeks off to settle him in. Antoine says the flat is already destroyed, two chewed cushions and a shoe. They're thinking about getting a dog walker for when Pieter goes back on the 17th. I said I'd have Otis some Saturdays if they want, they seemed keen
Xavier's applying for the PhD at Edinburgh, deadline January 15 2027. Needs a referee, asked if I'd do it. Yes. must write that reference by Christmas
Angela mentioned she's been at the bakery 10 yrs this month. Should get her something small, she likes those fancy jam things
Groceries, gym, call the bank about the card.
Rana texted from the airport, flying to Lagos for her cousin's wedding, back May 30th. Mango is with her neighbour.
Joanna's interview got cancelled, the company froze hiring. She's annoyed but has another one lined up on 6/2 with a charity.
Zhang moved to the Bristol office in September, says it's way better. Lives near the harbour now.

so emre's cat went missing on sunday night, the grey one, Smoke. they've put posters up everywhere. he was in bits at work. if I hear anything from the neighbours let him know. also ask how his sister Rosa's doing after her op, he said it was last Wednesday

Valentina V. aka Val - starts at the agency on Monday. First proper job after uni. Her mum's driving her down with all her stuff on Sunday. She found a room in a shared house near the office, two other grads. Her dog is staying at home with her parents for now, which she's sad about. Ring her Wednesday evening to see how the first few days went
Jakub's wife Zofia is expecting! Due in April. Their dog has no idea what's coming haha
Anya got it!!! Senior designer, starts June 1st. Send flowers
Mrs Petrov next door's parrot has a birthday party on Saturday. Genuinely. I'm invited.
Cem's wife wants to get him a watch for the promotion, asked if I'd chip in. Said yes, £30 to her by the 20th
Dr Nakamura retiring end of the year. Simone (works with her) says the whole clinic's sad about it. card going round next week, remember to sign
Rang Uncle Hemi. His back's still bad, he's off work till at least November 9th, physio twice a week. Seemed down. Call him again next weekend.
Fern's starting a new job as a vet nurse on 3/9, finally out of retail. She's done the course part time for 2 years

Luis has his citizenship test on May 22 and his job interview at the bank on May 24. Big week. He's weirdly calm about both. His mum is the opposite, she's been ringing him every evening to quiz him on the citizenship questions. The bank job would mean moving to Leeds by the end of summer, which his girlfriend Rosa isn't thrilled about. Text him on the 24th after the interview
Just walked the dog for Rana while she's away. Mango ate a sock. Do not tell Rana.
Note to self: update CV this weekend and apply for the Murphy & Thomas role before the 28th.
Connor's last day was Friday — he said the send-off was lovely, they gave him a signed shirt. Starting the new one 2 December 2026. Ask him how the new place is after his first week
Kaito's interview at Sony is on the 7th, he is NOT nervous, apparently. hm.
Andre and Chantal's anniversary is October 30. They're going to Lisbon for it, leaving the 28th, back the 2nd. I'm feeding their cat Nugget while they're gone. Need to get the key off Andre by Monday
Efua — doesn't like surprises, likes hiking, oat milk only
So Samir didn't get the warehouse job. He's got another interview lined up for July 8 at a garden centre which he'd actually prefer. Text him Monday to see how he's feeling
Pieter said Otis has puppy classes Tuesdays at 7. he's top of the class allegedly
angela's son James graduates in July, she's so proud. he wants to go into teaching

Fatima's thinking about leaving nursing altogether. Burnt out. Wants to retrain as a teacher, maybe September 2027. Don't push it, just be around. Her sister Efua is a teacher and has offered to let her shadow a few days at her school in the new year, maybe late January. She sounded properly exhausted on the phone, said she's been doing nights for three weeks straight
Jun had a scare with Mochi, swallowed a toy, emergency surgery last night. Recovering. text Jun tomorrow morning
Interview at 2 tomorrow. Iron the shirt.
lunch w/ Lachlan. He's got the apprenticeship!! starts Sept 1st. His dad wants to throw a party for him on the 30th

Zofia Kim - new hire on my team, starts Monday 11/3. Moved from Krakow. Make sure her laptop's ready and take her for lunch day one. HR said her badge won't be ready till the Wednesday so someone has to let her in. She mentioned on the call that she has a little boy, Kaito, starting nursery here the same week, so she might need to leave early a couple of days. Fine by me
Valentina's dad's retirement do confirmed for 14 March 2027 at the golf club. Luis is booked. I'll drive.
Rosa's cat Pepper had her checkup yesterday and the kidney numbers are stable! Rosa much happier.

Xavier mentioned his girlfriend Joanna has an interview with the BBC on the 19th. He said she's been practising answers on him every night for a week, poor guy. I should message her the day before to say good luck. Also his PhD interview at Edinburgh got moved to February 4 2027.
Karan's hints: coffee grinder, the Baratza one, not the cheap one.
Hamster died. Kids devastated. Burial in the garden after school tomorrow.

Simone has an interview at the hospice on 4/21, the job she actually wants, admin lead. she is a wreck about it. her husband Zhang is taking the day off to go with her for moral support. send her something the night before
Antoine. Promoted to head chef as of April 2027, current head chef retiring. He's thrilled.

Had coffee with Emre. Smoke came home!! Thin but fine. He's bought a GPS collar now. Also he mentioned he's quitting the warehouse in December, wants to do a coding bootcamp starting January 12. His girlfriend Angela thinks it's a great idea, his parents not so much. He's been doing tutorials every night after work for about six months. He seems determined. Must remember to send him that list of courses Jakub recommended
